name: @azohra/meteo.forecast
description: The forecast engine of meteo by Azohra: fetches provider bytes (ECCC Datamart, NOAA Open Data), samples gridpoints, derives site forecasts, and publishes the versioned JSON documents and history archives that @azohra/meteo.briefing reads - the write side of the contract that package's read side validates.
author: Justin Watts

scripts.test: pnpm --dir ../briefing build && pnpm --dir ../grib build && vp test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir ../briefing build && pnpm --dir ../grib build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
